name: Files Studio
description: A unified file workspace for local folders, S3-compatible storage, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, Tencent COS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, and other rclone storage backends.

contributions.label: Storage
contributions.description: Storage connection backed by rclone: local filesystem, S3/MinIO, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, or any other rclone backend.

fields.label: Connection name
fields.description: Name shown in the connection list.

fields.label: Protocol
fields.description: Pick a storage backend: popular backends get a dedicated form; generic backends reuse the common fields and take extra options as JSON.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: Service address. Object storage/WebDAV: https://host; FTP: ftp(s)://host[:21]; SFTP: ssh://user@host[:22]; SMB: host[:445]; http: full URL; hdfs: namenode:8020; netstorage/quatrix: host name; azurefiles: optional service URL. S3-compatible vendors take their vendor S3 endpoint: R2 https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; Wasabi https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com; Spaces https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com; Scaleway https://s3.<region>.scw.cloud; IDrive e2 account endpoint; US3 https://s3-<region>.ufileos.com; China Mobile EOS https://eos-<region>-1.cmecloud.cn; Netease NOS https://s3.netease.com; BOS https://s3.<region>.bcebos.com; TOS https://tos-s3-<region>.volces.com; KS3 https://s3.<region>.ksyuncs.com.

fields.label: Advanced options (JSON)
fields.description: Optional extra options for the selected backend as a JSON object, using the option names from rclone's docs. Unknown options are rejected with the list of valid names; common settings have dedicated fields above.

fields.label: Access token
fields.description: OAuth or API access token issued by the provider (drive services, box, drime, gofile); add a refresh token for OAuth so it renews automatically.

fields.label: OAuth client ID
fields.description: OAuth client ID of a registered application, for OAuth-configured cloud backends (drive services, box, hidrive, huaweidrive, jottacloud, mailru, premiumizeme, putio, sharefile, zoho).

fields.label: OAuth client secret
fields.description: OAuth client secret of the registered application, kept in the host secret binding.

fields.label: OAuth refresh token
fields.description: OAuth refresh token used to mint new access tokens when the current one expires.

fields.label: Drive type
fields.description: Which Alibaba Drive space to open: personal (resource), shared, or backup.

fields.label: Account email
fields.description: Koofr account email used to sign in.

fields.label: Library name
fields.description: Name of an existing Seafile library to open.

fields.label: Bucket
fields.description: Bucket name. Leave empty to list all buckets at the connection root.

fields.label: Container
fields.description: Azure Blob container. Leave empty to list all containers at the connection root.

fields.label: Account name
fields.description: Azure Storage account name.

fields.label: Account key
fields.description: Azure Storage account key kept in the host secret binding.

fields.label: Credential JSON (base64)
fields.description: Google service-account or external-account credential, kept in the host secret binding.

fields.label: OAuth scope
fields.description: Optional Google OAuth scope; leave empty for the default.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: S3 region; leave empty to default to us-east-1 (AWS, MinIO, Ceph).

fields.label: Virtual-host style
fields.description: Address buckets as virtual hostnames (bucket.host) instead of path-style URLs; enable when the provider requires it.

fields.label: Access key ID
fields.description: Access key or public identifier: S3-compatible access key ID (s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3 — for R2, the Access Key ID of an R2 API token); b2 account ID; azurefiles storage account; qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync access key; cloudinary API key; imagekit public key.

fields.label: Secret access key
fields.description: Secret kept in the host secret binding: S3-compatible secret access key (s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3 — for R2, the Secret Access Key of an R2 API token); b2 application key; azurefiles account key; qingstor/internetarchive access secret; sugarsync private access key; cloudinary API secret; imagekit private key.

fields.label: API key / token
fields.description: API key, token, or access grant, kept in the host secret binding: fichier/filelu/pixeldrain/quatrix/shade API key, ulozto app token, linkbox token, storj access grant, filen API key, filefabric permanent token.

fields.label: Secret ID
fields.description: Tencent Cloud SecretId of the API key pair.

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.description: Tencent Cloud SecretKey, kept in the host secret binding.

fields.label: Security token (optional)
fields.description: Session token required when signing in with temporary (STS) credentials; leave empty for permanent keys.

fields.label: Share
fields.description: Optional share for SMB and azurefiles; leave empty to list server shares. share/sub/path uses the sub-path as the root.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Login name. WebDAV/SMB/pCloud/Seafile user; azurefiles/netstorage: account; cloudinary: cloud name; iclouddrive: Apple ID; filen/internxt/linkbox: email; hdfs/swift/ulozto/protondrive: user name.

fields.label: User
fields.description: FTP: empty = anonymous. SFTP: SSH login user (user@ in the endpoint also works).

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: NTLM domain or workgroup; leave empty when not needed.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Login password or secret. WebDAV/FTP/SMB password (FTP with empty user = anonymous); native SFTP accepts passwords, plain SFTP is key-only; swift: storage key; sia: API daemon password; netstorage: account secret.

fields.label: Private key or path
fields.description: Private key path on the DBX machine (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). Native SFTP also accepts PEM content when the password is empty. Encrypted keys are unsupported.

fields.label: Known hosts strategy
fields.description: Strict verifies against known host keys; Tolerate accepts new hosts but rejects changed keys; Trust skips verification (insecure).

fields.label: Display filename encoding
fields.description: For FTP servers that store names in a non-UTF-8 legacy encoding (e.g. Chinese GBK servers showing garbled names). Auto keeps rclone UTF-8 behavior; display only — file operations keep working.

fields.label: Root path
fields.description: All operations are confined under this root when set.

fields.label: Lock navigation to root
fields.description: Reject any path outside the configured root.

fields.label: Operation timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Per-operation timeout in seconds; leave empty for the 30s default (minimum 1).

fields.label: Read only
fields.description: Reject every write operation on this connection.

fields.label: Allow delete
fields.description: When off, delete/purge operations are rejected.

contributions.label: Files Workbench
contributions.description: Browse, transfer, and sync files across connected storage services.

zh-CN.name: Files Studio
zh-CN.description: 统一管理本地文件夹、S3 兼容存储、腾讯云 COS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 及其他 rclone 存储后端的文件工作台。

io.dbx.files.connection.label: 存储
io.dbx.files.connection.description: 基于 rclone 的存储连接：本地文件系统、S3/MinIO、阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、华为云 OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 或任意其他 rclone 后端。

display_name.label: 连接名称
display_name.description: 显示在连接列表中的名称。

protocol.label: 协议
protocol.description: 选择存储后端：常见后端有专属表单；通用后端复用下方通用字段，额外选项以 JSON 提供。

root.label: 根路径
root.description: 设置后所有操作都限制在该根路径内。

lock_to_root.label: 锁定在根路径内
lock_to_root.description: 拒绝任何超出所配置根路径的操作。

config.label: 高级选项（JSON）
config.description: 所选后端的可选附加选项，以 JSON 对象填写，键名为 rclone 文档中的选项名。未知选项会被拒绝并列出有效名称；常用设置请使用上方对应字段。

container.label: 容器
container.description: Azure Blob 容器名称；留空则在连接根目录列出全部容器。

account_key.label: 账户密钥
account_key.description: Azure Storage 账户密钥由宿主 secret binding 保管。

credential.label: 凭据 JSON（Base64）
credential.placeholder: Base64 编码的服务账户 JSON
credential.description: Google 服务账户或外部账户凭据，由宿主 secret binding 保管。

scope.label: OAuth 作用域
scope.description: 可选的 Google OAuth 作用域；留空使用默认值。

bucket.label: 存储桶
bucket.description: 存储桶名称；留空则在连接根目录列出全部存储桶。

endpoint.label: 端点
endpoint.description: 服务地址。对象存储/WebDAV：https://host；FTP：ftp(s)://host[:21]；SFTP：ssh://user@host[:22]；SMB：host[:445]；http：完整 URL；hdfs：namenode:8020；netstorage/quatrix：主机名；azurefiles：可选服务 URL。 S3 兼容厂商填写其 S3 端点：R2 https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com；Wasabi https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com；Spaces https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com；Scaleway https://s3.<region>.scw.cloud；IDrive e2 账号端点；US3 https://s3-<region>.ufileos.com；移动云 EOS https://eos-<region>-1.cmecloud.cn；网易数帆 NOS https://s3.netease.com；BOS https://s3.<region>.bcebos.com；TOS https://tos-s3-<region>.volces.com；KS3 https://s3.<region>.ksyuncs.com。

share.label: 共享名
share.description: SMB 与 azurefiles 的可选共享名；留空则列出服务器共享。share/sub/path 以子路径作为根目录。

region.label: 区域
region.description: S3 区域；留空时默认使用 us-east-1（AWS、MinIO、Ceph 通用）。

access_key_id.label: Access Key ID
access_key_id.description: 访问密钥或公开标识：S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu 的 Access Key ID；b2 账户 ID；azurefiles 存储账户；qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync 访问密钥；cloudinary API 密钥；imagekit 公钥。 S3 兼容协议（s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3）的 Access Key ID（R2 填 R2 API 令牌的 Access Key ID）

secret_access_key.label: Secret Access Key
secret_access_key.description: 由宿主 secret binding 保管的机密：S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu 的 Secret Key；b2 应用密钥；azurefiles 账户密钥；qingstor/internetarchive 访问私钥；sugarsync 私有访问密钥；cloudinary API 密钥；imagekit 私钥。 S3 兼容协议的 Secret Access Key（协议范围同访问密钥；R2 填 R2 API 令牌的 Secret Access Key）

secret_id.label: Secret ID
secret_id.description: 腾讯云 API 密钥对的 SecretId。

secret_key.label: Secret Key
secret_key.description: 腾讯云 SecretKey，由宿主 secret binding 保管。

security_token.label: Security Token（可选）
security_token.description: 使用临时（STS）密钥时必填的会话令牌；永久密钥留空即可。

username.label: 用户名
username.description: 登录名。WebDAV/SMB/pCloud/Seafile 用户；azurefiles/netstorage：账户；cloudinary：云空间名称；iclouddrive：Apple ID；filen/internxt/linkbox：邮箱；hdfs/swift/ulozto/protondrive：用户名。

domain.label: 域
domain.description: NTLM 域或工作组；不需要时留空。

user.label: 用户
user.description: FTP 留空为匿名；SFTP 填 SSH 登录用户（地址中带 user@ 亦可）。

password.label: 密码
password.description: 登录密码或机密。WebDAV/FTP/SMB 密码（FTP 用户留空即匿名）；SFTP（原生）支持密码，SFTP 仅支持密钥；swift：存储密钥；sia：API 守护进程密码；netstorage：账户机密。

key.label: 私钥或私钥路径
key.description: DBX 所在机器上的私钥路径（如 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519）。SFTP（原生）在密码为空时也可粘贴 PEM 内容。不支持加密私钥。

known_hosts_strategy.label: Known Hosts 策略
known_hosts_strategy.description: Strict 校验已知主机密钥；Tolerate 接受新主机但拒绝密钥变化；Trust 跳过验证（不安全）。

access_token.label: Access Token
access_token.description: 服务商签发的 OAuth 或 API 访问令牌（网盘服务及 box、drime、gofile）；OAuth 场景建议同时填写刷新令牌以便自动续期。

client_id.label: OAuth 客户端 ID
client_id.description: 已注册应用的 OAuth 客户端 ID，用于配置了 OAuth 的云后端（网盘服务及 box、hidrive、huaweidrive、jottacloud、mailru、premiumizeme、putio、sharefile、zoho）。

client_secret.label: OAuth 客户端密钥
client_secret.description: 已注册应用的 OAuth 客户端密钥，由宿主 secret binding 保管。

refresh_token.label: OAuth 刷新令牌
refresh_token.description: OAuth 刷新令牌，用于在访问令牌过期后换取新令牌。

drive_type.label: 云盘类型
drive_type.description: 选择要打开的阿里云盘空间：资源盘（个人）、共享盘或备份盘。

email.label: 账户邮箱
email.description: 用于登录的 Koofr 账户邮箱。

repo_name.label: 资料库名称
repo_name.description: 要打开的 Seafile 资料库名称（需已存在）。

read_only.label: 只读
read_only.description: 拒绝该连接上的所有写操作。

allow_delete.label: 允许删除
allow_delete.description: 关闭后，删除/清空操作会被拒绝。

timeout_secs.label: 操作超时（秒）
timeout_secs.description: 单次操作超时秒数；留空使用默认 30 秒（最小 1）。

enable_virtual_host_style.label: 虚拟主机风格
enable_virtual_host_style.description: 以虚拟主机名（bucket.host）而非路径风格 URL 寻址存储桶；服务商要求时开启。

token.label: API 密钥 / 令牌
token.description: API 密钥、令牌或访问授权，由宿主 secret binding 保管：fichier/filelu/pixeldrain/quatrix/shade 的 API 密钥、ulozto 应用令牌、linkbox 令牌、storj 访问授权、filen API 密钥、filefabric 永久令牌。

display_charset.label: 文件名显示编码
display_charset.description: 适用于文件名使用非 UTF-8 旧编码的 FTP 服务器（如中文 GBK 服务器显示乱码）。自动 = UTF-8；仅影响显示，文件操作不受影响。

io.dbx.files.workbench.label: 文件工作台
io.dbx.files.workbench.description: 在已连接的存储服务之间浏览、传输与同步文件。

zh-TW.name: Files Studio
zh-TW.description: 統一管理本機資料夾、S3 相容儲存、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 及其他 rclone 儲存後端的檔案工作台。

io.dbx.files.connection.label: 儲存
io.dbx.files.connection.description: 基於 rclone 的儲存連線：本機檔案系統、S3/MinIO、阿里雲 OSS、騰訊雲 COS、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、華為雲 OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 或任意其他 rclone 後端。

display_name.label: 連線名稱
display_name.description: 顯示在連線清單中的名稱。

protocol.label: 通訊協定
protocol.description: 選擇儲存後端：常見後端有專屬表單；通用後端重複使用下方通用欄位，額外選項以 JSON 提供。

root.label: 根路徑
root.description: 設定後所有操作都限制在該根路徑內。

lock_to_root.label: 鎖定在根路徑內
lock_to_root.description: 拒絕任何超出所設定根路徑的操作。

config.label: 進階選項（JSON）
config.description: 所選後端的可選附加選項，以 JSON 物件填寫，鍵名為 rclone 文件中的選項名。未知選項會被拒絕並列出有效名稱；常用設定請使用上方對應欄位。

container.label: 容器
container.description: Azure Blob 容器名稱；留空則在連線根目錄列出全部容器。

account_key.label: 帳戶金鑰
account_key.description: Azure Storage 帳戶金鑰由宿主 secret binding 保管。

credential.label: 憑證 JSON（Base64）
credential.placeholder: Base64 編碼的服務帳戶 JSON
credential.description: Google 服務帳戶或外部帳戶憑證，由宿主 secret binding 保管。

scope.label: OAuth 範圍
scope.description: 可選的 Google OAuth 範圍；留空使用預設值。

bucket.label: 儲存桶
bucket.description: 儲存桶名稱；留空則在連線根目錄列出全部儲存桶。

endpoint.label: 端點
endpoint.description: 服務位址。物件儲存/WebDAV：https://host；FTP：ftp(s)://host[:21]；SFTP：ssh://user@host[:22]；SMB：host[:445]；http：完整 URL；hdfs：namenode:8020；netstorage/quatrix：主機名稱；azurefiles：可選服務 URL。 S3 相容廠商填寫其 S3 端點：R2 https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com；Wasabi https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com；Spaces https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com；Scaleway https://s3.<region>.scw.cloud；IDrive e2 帳號端點；US3 https://s3-<region>.ufileos.com；移動雲 EOS https://eos-<region>-1.cmecloud.cn；網易數帆 NOS https://s3.netease.com；BOS https://s3.<region>.bcebos.com；TOS https://tos-s3-<region>.volces.com；KS3 https://s3.<region>.ksyuncs.com。

share.label: 共用名稱
share.description: SMB 與 azurefiles 的可選共享名稱；留空則列出伺服器共享。share/sub/path 以子路徑作為根目錄。

region.label: 區域
region.description: S3 區域；留空時預設使用 us-east-1（AWS、MinIO、Ceph 通用）。

access_key_id.label: Access Key ID
access_key_id.description: 存取金鑰或公開識別：S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu 的 Access Key ID；b2 帳戶 ID；azurefiles 儲存體帳戶；qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync 存取金鑰；cloudinary API 金鑰；imagekit 公鑰。 S3 相容協定（s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3）的 Access Key ID（R2 填 R2 API 權杖的 Access Key ID）

secret_access_key.label: Secret Access Key
secret_access_key.description: 由宿主 secret binding 保管的機密：S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu 的 Secret Key；b2 應用程式金鑰；azurefiles 帳戶金鑰；qingstor/internetarchive 存取私鑰；sugarsync 私有存取金鑰；cloudinary API 金鑰；imagekit 私鑰。 S3 相容協定的 Secret Access Key（協定範圍同存取金鑰；R2 填 R2 API 權杖的 Secret Access Key）

secret_id.label: Secret ID
secret_id.description: 騰訊雲 API 金鑰對的 SecretId。

secret_key.label: Secret Key
secret_key.description: 騰訊雲 SecretKey，由宿主 secret binding 保管。

security_token.label: Security Token（選填）
security_token.description: 使用暫時（STS）金鑰時必填的工作階段權杖；永久金鑰留空即可。

username.label: 使用者名稱
username.description: 登入名稱。WebDAV/SMB/pCloud/Seafile 使用者；azurefiles/netstorage：帳戶；cloudinary：雲端空間名稱；iclouddrive：Apple ID；filen/internxt/linkbox：信箱；hdfs/swift/ulozto/protondrive：使用者名稱。

domain.label: 網域
domain.description: NTLM 網域或工作群組；不需要時留空。

user.label: 使用者
user.description: FTP 留空為匿名；SFTP 填 SSH 登入使用者（位址中帶 user@ 亦可）。

password.label: 密碼
password.description: 登入密碼或機密。WebDAV/FTP/SMB 密碼（FTP 使用者留空即匿名）；SFTP（原生）支援密碼，SFTP 僅支援金鑰；swift：儲存金鑰；sia：API 常駐程式密碼；netstorage：帳戶機密。

key.label: 私鑰或私鑰路徑
key.description: DBX 所在機器上的私鑰路徑（如 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519）。SFTP（原生）在密碼為空時也可貼上 PEM 內容。不支援加密私鑰。

known_hosts_strategy.label: Known Hosts 策略

access_token.label: Access Token
access_token.description: 服務商簽發的 OAuth 或 API 存取權杖（網盤服務及 box、drime、gofile）；OAuth 場景建議同時填寫重新整理權杖以便自動續期。

client_id.label: OAuth 用戶端 ID
client_id.description: 已註冊應用的 OAuth 用戶端 ID，用於設定了 OAuth 的雲端後端（網盤服務及 box、hidrive、huaweidrive、jottacloud、mailru、premiumizeme、putio、sharefile、zoho）。

client_secret.label: OAuth 用戶端密鑰
client_secret.description: 已註冊應用的 OAuth 用戶端金鑰，由宿主 secret binding 保管。

refresh_token.label: OAuth 更新權杖
refresh_token.description: OAuth 重新整理權杖，用於在存取權杖過期後換取新權杖。

drive_type.label: 雲端硬碟類型
drive_type.description: 選擇要開啟的阿里雲盤空間：資源盤（個人）、共享盤或備份盤。

email.label: 帳戶電子郵件
email.description: 用於登入的 Koofr 帳戶信箱。

repo_name.label: 資料庫名稱
repo_name.description: 要開啟的 Seafile 資料庫名稱（需已存在）。

read_only.label: 唯讀
read_only.description: 拒絕該連線上的所有寫入操作。

io.dbx.files.connection.label: Storage

display_name.label: Connection name
display_name.description: Name shown in the connection list.

protocol.label: Protocol
protocol.description: Pick a storage backend: popular backends get a dedicated form; generic backends reuse the common fields and take extra options as JSON.

root.label: Root path
root.description: All operations are confined under this root when set.

lock_to_root.label: Lock navigation to root
lock_to_root.description: Reject any path outside the configured root.

config.label: Advanced options (JSON)
config.description: Optional extra options for the selected backend as a JSON object, using the option names from rclone's docs. Unknown options are rejected with the list of valid names; common settings have dedicated fields above.

container.label: Container
container.description: Azure Blob container. Leave empty to list all containers at the connection root.

account_key.label: Account key
account_key.description: Azure Storage account key kept in the host secret binding.

credential.label: Credential JSON (base64)
credential.description: Google service-account or external-account credential, kept in the host secret binding.

scope.label: OAuth scope
scope.description: Optional Google OAuth scope; leave empty for the default.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: Bucket name. Leave empty to list all buckets at the connection root.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Service address. Object storage/WebDAV: https://host; FTP: ftp(s)://host[:21]; SFTP: ssh://user@host[:22]; SMB: host[:445]; http: full URL; hdfs: namenode:8020; netstorage/quatrix: host name; azurefiles: optional service URL. S3-compatible vendors take their vendor S3 endpoint: R2 https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; Wasabi https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com; Spaces https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com; Scaleway https://s3.<region>.scw.cloud; IDrive e2 account endpoint; US3 https://s3-<region>.ufileos.com; China Mobile EOS https://eos-<region>-1.cmecloud.cn; Netease NOS https://s3.netease.com; BOS https://s3.<region>.bcebos.com; TOS https://tos-s3-<region>.volces.com; KS3 https://s3.<region>.ksyuncs.com.

share.label: Share
share.description: Optional share for SMB and azurefiles; leave empty to list server shares. share/sub/path uses the sub-path as the root.

region.label: Region
region.description: S3 region; leave empty to default to us-east-1 (AWS, MinIO, Ceph).

access_key_id.label: Access key ID
access_key_id.description: Access key or public identifier: S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu access key ID; b2 account ID; azurefiles storage account; qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync access key; cloudinary API key; imagekit public key. S3-compatible access key ID (s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3 — for R2, the Access Key ID of an R2 API token)

secret_access_key.label: Secret access key
secret_access_key.description: Secret kept in the host secret binding: S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu secret key; b2 application key; azurefiles account key; qingstor/internetarchive access secret; sugarsync private access key; cloudinary API secret; imagekit private key. S3-compatible secret access key (s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3 — for R2, the Secret Access Key of an R2 API token)

secret_id.label: Secret ID
secret_id.description: Tencent Cloud SecretId of the API key pair.

secret_key.label: Secret key
secret_key.description: Tencent Cloud SecretKey, kept in the host secret binding.

security_token.label: Security token (optional)
security_token.description: Session token required when signing in with temporary (STS) credentials; leave empty for permanent keys.

username.label: Username
username.description: Login name. WebDAV/SMB/pCloud/Seafile user; azurefiles/netstorage: account; cloudinary: cloud name; iclouddrive: Apple ID; filen/internxt/linkbox: email; hdfs/swift/ulozto/protondrive: user name.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: NTLM domain or workgroup; leave empty when not needed.

user.label: User
user.description: FTP: empty = anonymous. SFTP: SSH login user (user@ in the endpoint also works).

password.label: Password
password.description: Login password or secret. WebDAV/FTP/SMB password (FTP with empty user = anonymous); native SFTP accepts passwords, plain SFTP is key-only; swift: storage key; sia: API daemon password; netstorage: account secret.

key.label: Private key or path
key.description: Private key path on the DBX machine (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). Native SFTP also accepts PEM content when the password is empty. Encrypted keys are unsupported.

known_hosts_strategy.label: Known hosts strategy
known_hosts_strategy.description: Strict verifies against known host keys; Tolerate accepts new hosts but rejects changed keys; Trust skips verification (insecure).

access_token.label: Access token
access_token.description: OAuth or API access token issued by the provider (drive services, box, drime, gofile); add a refresh token for OAuth so it renews automatically.

client_id.label: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: OAuth client ID of a registered application, for OAuth-configured cloud backends (drive services, box, hidrive, huaweidrive, jottacloud, mailru, premiumizeme, putio, sharefile, zoho).

client_secret.label: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: OAuth client secret of the registered application, kept in the host secret binding.

refresh_token.label: OAuth refresh token
refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token used to mint new access tokens when the current one expires.

drive_type.label: Drive type
drive_type.description: Which Alibaba Drive space to open: personal (resource), shared, or backup.

email.label: Account email
email.description: Koofr account email used to sign in.

repo_name.label: Library name
repo_name.description: Name of an existing Seafile library to open.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: Reject every write operation on this connection.

allow_delete.label: Allow delete
allow_delete.description: When off, delete/purge operations are rejected.

timeout_secs.label: Operation timeout (seconds)
timeout_secs.description: Per-operation timeout in seconds; leave empty for the 30s default (minimum 1).

enable_virtual_host_style.label: Virtual-host style
enable_virtual_host_style.description: Address buckets as virtual hostnames (bucket.host) instead of path-style URLs; enable when the provider requires it.

token.label: API key / token
token.description: API key, token, or access grant, kept in the host secret binding: fichier/filelu/pixeldrain/quatrix/shade API key, ulozto app token, linkbox token, storj access grant, filen API key, filefabric permanent token.

display_charset.label: Display filename encoding
display_charset.description: For FTP servers that store names in a non-UTF-8 legacy encoding (e.g. Chinese GBK servers showing garbled names). Auto keeps UTF-8 behavior; display only — file operations keep working.

io.dbx.files.workbench.label: Files Workbench

display_name.label: Nombre de la conexión
display_name.description: Nombre mostrado en la lista de conexiones.

container.label: Contenedor
container.description: Contenedor de Azure Blob; déjelo vacío para listar todos los contenedores en la raíz de la conexión.

account_name.label: Nombre de cuenta
account_name.description: Nombre de la cuenta de Azure Storage.

account_key.label: Clave de cuenta
account_key.description: La clave de Azure Storage se guarda en el binding secreto del host.

credential.label: Credencial JSON (Base64)
credential.placeholder: JSON de cuenta de servicio codificado en Base64
credential.description: Credencial de cuenta de servicio o cuenta externa de Google, guardada en el binding secreto del host.

scope.label: Ámbito OAuth
scope.description: Ámbito OAuth de Google opcional; déjelo vacío para usar el valor predeterminado.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: Nombre del bucket; déjelo vacío para listar todos los buckets en la raíz de la conexión.

share.label: Recurso compartido
share.description: Recurso compartido opcional para SMB y azurefiles; déjelo vacío para listar los recursos del servidor. share/sub/path usa la subruta como raíz.

region.label: Región
region.description: Región de S3; déjelo vacío para usar us-east-1 por defecto (AWS, MinIO, Ceph).

access_key_id.label: ID de clave de acceso
access_key_id.description: Clave de acceso o identificador público: Access Key ID de S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu; ID de cuenta de b2; cuenta de almacenamiento de azurefiles; clave de acceso de qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync; clave de API de cloudinary; clave pública de imagekit. secret_access_key.label: Clave de acceso secreta

domain.label: Dominio
domain.description: Dominio o grupo de trabajo NTLM; déjelo vacío si no es necesario.

user.label: Usuario
user.description: FTP: vacío = anónimo. SFTP: usuario SSH (user@ en el endpoint también vale).

repo_name.label: Nombre de biblioteca

enable_virtual_host_style.description: Indirizza il bucket come nome host virtuale (bucket.host) invece che URL in stile percorso; attivalo se il provider lo richiede.

token.label: Chiave API / token
token.description: Chiave API, token o access grant, conservato nel binding segreto dell'host: chiave API di fichier/filelu/pixeldrain/quatrix/shade, token applicazione di ulozto, token di linkbox, access grant di storj, chiave API di filen, token permanente di filefabric.

display_charset.label: Codifica di visualizzazione dei nomi
display_charset.description: Per server FTP che memorizzano i nomi in una codifica legacy non UTF-8 (ad es. server cinesi GBK che mostrano caratteri strani). Automatico mantiene UTF-8; influisce solo sulla visualizzazione, le operazioni restano invariate.

io.dbx.files.workbench.label: Banco di lavoro file
io.dbx.files.workbench.description: Sfoglia, trasferisci e sincronizza file tra i servizi di archiviazione connessi.

ja.name: Files Studio
ja.description: ローカルフォルダー、S3 互換ストレージ、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS など各種 rclone ストレージバックエンドを束ねた統合ファイルワークベンチ。

io.dbx.files.connection.label: ストレージ
io.dbx.files.connection.description: rclone ベースのストレージ接続：ローカルファイルシステム、S3/MinIO、Alibaba OSS、Tencent COS、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、Huawei OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS、またはその他の任意の rclone バックエンド。

display_name.label: 接続名
display_name.description: 接続リストに表示される名前です。

protocol.label: プロトコル

options.fs: ローカルファイルシステム

protocol.description: ストレージバックエンドを選択します。主要なバックエンドには専用フォームがあり、汎用バックエンドは共通フィールドを再利用し、追加オプションは JSON で設定します。

root.label: ルートパス
root.description: 設定すると、すべての操作がこのルート配下に制限されます。

lock_to_root.label: ルート内に制限
lock_to_root.description: 設定されたルート外のパスを拒否します。

config.label: 詳細オプション（JSON）
config.description: 選択したバックエンドの任意の追加オプションを JSON オブジェクトで設定します。キーは rclone ドキュメントのオプション名です。不明なオプションは有効な名前一覧とともに拒否されます。よく使う設定は上の専用フィールドをご利用ください。

container.label: コンテナー
container.description: Azure Blob コンテナー名。空欄で接続ルートに全コンテナーを一覧します。

account_name.label: アカウント名
account_name.description: Azure Storage アカウント名。

account_key.label: アカウントキー
account_key.description: Azure Storage アカウントキーはホストの secret binding に保存されます。

credential.label: 認証情報 JSON（Base64）
credential.placeholder: Base64 エンコードしたサービスアカウント JSON
credential.description: Google サービスアカウントまたは外部アカウントの認証情報。ホストの secret binding に保存されます。

scope.label: OAuth スコープ
scope.description: 任意の Google OAuth スコープ。空欄で既定値を使用します。

bucket.label: バケット
bucket.description: バケット名。空欄で接続ルートに全バケットを一覧します。

endpoint.label: エンドポイント
endpoint.description: サービスアドレス。オブジェクトストレージ/WebDAV：https://host、FTP：ftp(s)://host[:21]、SFTP：ssh://user@host[:22]、SMB：host[:445]、http：完全な URL、hdfs：namenode:8020、netstorage/quatrix：ホスト名、azurefiles：任意のサービス URL。 S3 互換ベンダーは各社の S3 エンドポイントを指定：R2 https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com、Wasabi https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com、Spaces https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com、Scaleway https://s3.<region>.scw.cloud、IDrive e2 はアカウント固有エンドポイント、US3 https://s3-<region>.ufileos.com、China Mobile EOS https://eos-<region>-1.cmecloud.cn、Netease NOS https://s3.netease.com、BOS https://s3.<region>.bcebos.com、TOS https://tos-s3-<region>.volces.com、KS3 https://s3.<region>.ksyuncs.com。

share.label: 共有名
share.description: SMB と azurefiles の任意の共有名。空欄でサーバーの共有一覧を表示します。share/sub/path はサブパスをルートとして扱います。

region.label: リージョン
region.description: S3 リージョン。空欄の場合は us-east-1（AWS・MinIO・Ceph の既定）を使用します。

access_key_id.label: アクセスキー ID
access_key_id.description: アクセスキーまたは公開識別子：S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu の Access Key ID、b2 のアカウント ID、azurefiles のストレージアカウント、qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync のアクセスキー、cloudinary の API キー、imagekit の公開キー。 S3 互換プロトコル（s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3）の Access Key ID（R2 は R2 API トークンの Access Key ID）

secret_access_key.label: シークレットアクセスキー
secret_access_key.description: ホストの secret binding に保存されるシークレット：S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu のシークレットキー、b2 のアプリケーションキー、azurefiles のアカウントキー、qingstor/internetarchive のアクセスシークレット、sugarsync のプライベートアクセスキー、cloudinary の API シークレット、imagekit の秘密キー。 S3 互換プロトコルのシークレットアクセスキー（対象はアクセスキーと同じプロトコル、R2 は R2 API トークンの Secret Access Key）

secret_id.label: Secret ID
secret_id.description: Tencent Cloud API キーペアの SecretId です。

secret_key.label: Secret key
secret_key.description: Tencent Cloud の SecretKey です。ホストの secret binding に保存されます。

security_token.label: セキュリティトークン（任意）
security_token.description: 一時的な（STS）認証情報でサインインする場合に必要なセッショントークンです。永続キーでは空欄のままにします。

username.label: ユーザー名
username.description: ログイン名。WebDAV/SMB/pCloud/Seafile のユーザー、azurefiles/netstorage：アカウント、cloudinary：クラウド名、iclouddrive：Apple ID、filen/internxt/linkbox：メールアドレス、hdfs/swift/ulozto/protondrive：ユーザー名。

domain.label: ドメイン
domain.description: NTLM ドメインまたはワークグループ。不要なら空にします。

user.label: ユーザー
user.description: FTP は空欄で匿名。SFTP は SSH ログインユーザー（user@ を含む endpoint も可）。

password.label: パスワード
password.description: ログインパスワードまたはシークレット。WebDAV/FTP/SMB のパスワード（FTP はユーザー空欄で匿名）。SFTP（ネイティブ）はパスワード対応、SFTP は鍵認証専用。swift：ストレージキー、sia：API デーモンパスワード、netstorage：アカウントシークレット。

key.label: 秘密鍵またはパス
key.description: DBX マシン上の秘密鍵パス（例: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519）。ネイティブ SFTP はパスワード未入力時に PEM も可。暗号化鍵は非対応です。

known_hosts_strategy.label: Known Hosts 戦略
known_hosts_strategy.description: Strict は既知のホスト鍵を検証、Tolerate は新規ホストを許可し鍵の変更を拒否、Trust は検証を省略（非安全）します。

options.Tolerate: 許容（新しいホストを記憶）
options.Trust: 信頼（任意の鍵・非安全）

access_token.label: アクセストークン
access_token.description: プロバイダーが発行した OAuth または API のアクセストークン（ドライブ系サービス、box、drime、gofile）。OAuth の場合はリフレッシュトークンを併せて設定すると自動更新されます。

client_id.label: OAuth クライアント ID
client_id.description: 登録済みアプリケーションの OAuth クライアント ID。OAuth 設定済みのクラウドバックエンド（ドライブ系サービス、box、hidrive、huaweidrive、jottacloud、mailru、premiumizeme、putio、sharefile、zoho）で使用します。

client_secret.label: OAuth クライアントシークレット
client_secret.description: 登録済みアプリケーションの OAuth クライアントシークレットです。ホストの secret binding に保存されます。

refresh_token.label: OAuth リフレッシュトークン
refresh_token.description: OAuth リフレッシュトークンです。アクセストークンの期限切れ時に新しいトークンを取得します。

drive_type.label: ドライブ種別

options.backup: バックアップドライブ

drive_type.description: 開く Alibaba Drive のスペースを選択します：個人用（リソース）、共有、バックアップ。

email.label: アカウントメール
email.description: サインインに使う Koofr アカウントのメールアドレスです。

repo_name.label: ライブラリ名
repo_name.description: 開く既存の Seafile ライブラリ名です。

read_only.label: 読み取り専用
read_only.description: この接続でのすべての書き込み操作を拒否します。

allow_delete.label: 削除を許可
allow_delete.description: オフにすると、削除/パージ操作を拒否します。

timeout_secs.label: 操作タイムアウト（秒）
timeout_secs.description: 1 操作あたりのタイムアウト秒数。空欄で既定 30 秒（最小 1）。

enable_virtual_host_style.label: バーチャルホスト形式
enable_virtual_host_style.description: パス形式ではなく仮想ホスト名（bucket.host）でバケットを指定します。プロバイダーが要求する場合に有効化します。

token.label: API キー / トークン
token.description: API キー・トークン・アクセスグラント。ホストの secret binding に保存されます：fichier/filelu/pixeldrain/quatrix/shade の API キー、ulozto のアプリトークン、linkbox のトークン、storj のアクセスグラント、filen の API キー、filefabric の永久トークン。

display_charset.label: ファイル名表示エンコーディング
display_charset.description: ファイル名が UTF-8 以外の旧エンコーディングで保存される FTP サーバー向け（例：中国語 GBK サーバーで文字化けする場合）。自動 = UTF-8。表示のみに影響し、ファイル操作には影響しません。

io.dbx.files.workbench.label: ファイルワークベンチ
io.dbx.files.workbench.description: 接続したストレージサービス間でファイルを閲覧・転送・同期します。

pt-BR.name: Files Studio
pt-BR.description: Espaço de trabalho unificado de arquivos para pastas locais, armazenamento compatível com S3, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS e outros backends de armazenamento do rclone.

io.dbx.files.connection.label: Armazenamento
io.dbx.files.connection.description: Conexão de armazenamento baseada no rclone: sistema de arquivos local, S3/MinIO, OSS da Alibaba, COS da Tencent, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, OBS da Huawei, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS ou qualquer outro backend do rclone.

display_name.label: Nome da conexão
display_name.description: Nome exibido na lista de conexões.

protocol.label: Protocolo
protocol.description: Escolha um backend de armazenamento: os mais comuns têm formulário próprio; os genéricos reutilizam os campos comuns e aceitam opções extras em JSON.

root.label: Caminho raiz
root.description: Se definida, todas as operações ficam confinadas sob esta raiz.

lock_to_root.label: Restringir à raiz
lock_to_root.description: Rejeita qualquer caminho fora da raiz configurada.

config.label: Opções avançadas (JSON)
config.description: Opções extras opcionais do backend selecionado como objeto JSON, usando os nomes de opção da documentação do rclone. Opções desconhecidas são rejeitadas com a lista de nomes válidos; as configurações comuns têm campos próprios acima.

container.label: Contêiner
container.description: Contêiner do Azure Blob; deixe vazio para listar todos os contêineres na raiz da conexão.

account_name.label: Nome da conta
account_name.description: Nome da conta do Azure Storage.

account_key.label: Chave da conta
account_key.description: A chave do Azure Storage fica no binding secreto do host.

credential.label: Credencial JSON (Base64)
credential.placeholder: JSON da conta de serviço codificado em Base64
credential.description: Credencial de conta de serviço ou conta externa do Google, armazenada no binding secreto do host.

scope.label: Escopo OAuth
scope.description: Escopo OAuth do Google opcional; deixe vazio para usar o padrão.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: Nome do bucket; deixe vazio para listar todos os buckets na raiz da conexão.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Endereço do serviço. Armazenamento de objetos/WebDAV: https://host; FTP: ftp(s)://host[:21]; SFTP: ssh://user@host[:22]; SMB: host[:445]; http: URL completa; hdfs: namenode:8020; netstorage/quatrix: nome do host; azurefiles: URL de serviço opcional. Provedores compatíveis com S3 usam o endpoint S3 deles: R2 https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; Wasabi https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com; Spaces https://<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com; Scaleway https://s3.<region>.scw.cloud; IDrive e2 endpoint da conta; US3 https://s3-<region>.ufileos.com; China Mobile EOS https://eos-<region>-1.cmecloud.cn; Netease NOS https://s3.netease.com; BOS https://s3.<region>.bcebos.com; TOS https://tos-s3-<region>.volces.com; KS3 https://s3.<region>.ksyuncs.com.

share.label: Compartilhamento
share.description: Compartilhamento opcional para SMB e azurefiles; deixe vazio para listar os compartilhamentos do servidor. share/sub/path usa o subcaminho como raiz.

region.label: Região
region.description: Região do S3; deixe vazio para usar us-east-1 como padrão (AWS, MinIO, Ceph).

access_key_id.label: ID da chave de acesso
access_key_id.description: Chave de acesso ou identificador público: Access Key ID de S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu; ID de conta do b2; conta de armazenamento do azurefiles; chave de acesso de qingstor/internetarchive/sugarsync; chave de API do cloudinary; chave pública do imagekit. Access Key ID dos protocolos compatíveis com S3 (s3/obs/oss/qiniu/r2/wasabi/spaces/scaleway/idrive/us3/ecloud/nos/bos/tos/ks3; no R2, o Access Key ID de um token de API do R2)

secret_access_key.label: Chave de acesso secreta
secret_access_key.description: Segredo guardado no binding secreto do host: chave secreta de S3/OBS/OSS/Qiniu; chave de aplicativo do b2; chave de conta do azurefiles; segredo de acesso de qingstor/internetarchive; chave de acesso privada do sugarsync; segredo de API do cloudinary; chave privada do imagekit. Chave secreta dos protocolos compatíveis com S3 (mesmos protocolos da chave de acesso; no R2, o Secret Access Key de um token de API do R2)

secret_id.label: ID secreto
secret_id.description: SecretId do par de chaves de API da Tencent Cloud.

secret_key.label: Chave secreta
secret_key.description: SecretKey da Tencent Cloud, guardado no binding secreto do host.

security_token.label: Token de segurança (opcional)
security_token.description: Token de sessão necessário ao autenticar com credenciais temporárias (STS); deixe vazio para chaves permanentes.

username.label: Nome de usuário
username.description: Nome de login. Usuário de WebDAV/SMB/pCloud/Seafile; azurefiles/netstorage: conta; cloudinary: nome da nuvem; iclouddrive: Apple ID; filen/internxt/linkbox: e-mail; hdfs/swift/ulozto/protondrive: nome de usuário.

domain.label: Domínio
domain.description: Domínio ou workgroup NTLM; deixe vazio se não for necessário.

user.label: Usuário
user.description: FTP: vazio = anônimo. SFTP: usuário SSH (user@ no endpoint também vale).

password.label: Senha
password.description: Senha ou segredo de login. Senha de WebDAV/FTP/SMB (FTP com usuário vazio = anônimo); SFTP (nativo) aceita senha, SFTP normal apenas chave; swift: chave de armazenamento; sia: senha do daemon de API; netstorage: segredo da conta.

key.label: Chave privada ou caminho
key.description: Caminho da chave privada na máquina DBX (ex.: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). SFTP nativo também aceita conteúdo PEM com senha vazia. Chaves criptografadas não são suportadas.

known_hosts_strategy.label: Estratégia de known hosts
known_hosts_strategy.description: Strict verifica chaves conhecidas; Tolerate aceita novos hosts mas rejeita chaves alteradas; Trust ignora a verificação (inseguro).

access_token.label: Token de acesso
access_token.description: Token de acesso OAuth ou de API emitido pelo provedor (serviços de drive, box, drime, gofile); para OAuth adicione um refresh token para renová-lo automaticamente.

client_id.label: ID do cliente OAuth
client_id.description: Client ID OAuth de um aplicativo registrado, para backends de nuvem configurados com OAuth (serviços de drive, box, hidrive, huaweidrive, jottacloud, mailru, premiumizeme, putio, sharefile, zoho).

client_secret.label: Segredo do cliente OAuth
client_secret.description: Client secret OAuth do aplicativo registrado, guardado no binding secreto do host.

refresh_token.label: Token de atualização OAuth
refresh_token.description: Refresh token OAuth usado para obter novos tokens de acesso quando o atual expira.

drive_type.label: Tipo de unidade
drive_type.description: Espaço do Alibaba Drive a abrir: pessoal (resource), compartilhado ou backup.

email.label: E-mail da conta
email.description: E-mail da conta Koofr usado para entrar.

repo_name.label: Nome da biblioteca
repo_name.description: Nome de uma biblioteca Seafile existente a ser aberta.

read_only.label: Somente leitura
read_only.description: Rejeita toda operação de gravação nesta conexão.

allow_delete.label: Permitir exclusão
allow_delete.description: Quando desativado, as operações de exclusão/purge são rejeitadas.

timeout_secs.label: Tempo limite da operação (segundos)
timeout_secs.description: Tempo limite por operação em segundos; vazio = 30 s padrão (mínimo 1).

enable_virtual_host_style.label: Estilo virtual-host
enable_virtual_host_style.description: Endereça o bucket como nome de host virtual (bucket.host) em vez de URL estilo caminho; ative se o provedor exigir.

token.label: Chave de API / token
token.description: Chave de API, token ou access grant, guardado no binding secreto do host: chave de API de fichier/filelu/pixeldrain/quatrix/shade, token de aplicativo do ulozto, token do linkbox, access grant do storj, chave de API do filen, token permanente do filefabric.

display_charset.label: Codificação de exibição de nomes
display_charset.description: Para servidores FTP que armazenam nomes em uma codificação legada não UTF-8 (ex.: servidores chineses GBK exibindo caracteres corrompidos). Automático mantém UTF-8; afeta apenas a exibição, as operações não mudam.

io.dbx.files.workbench.label: Bancada de arquivos
io.dbx.files.workbench.description: Navegue, transfira e sincronize arquivos entre os serviços de armazenamento conectados.
